subject: [hw] DONE DEC03 rev 3: VLD/AVC_VLD/HEVC_VLD + LAT model, vendor differential; N2TEST DEC03 PASS 2781/2781
body:
DONE DEC03 rev 3. Supersedes the rev-2 DONE: the model now matches the verified per-slice use (AVC read(n)=post-shift window, LAT units, VLD latch/start-code/MISC/larb) and REGISTERS.md carries the parseSliceHeaderHW dead-code correction. Host only: no phone, no publish, nothing outside tests/hw/vdec/** and my STATUS.md.

Last lines:
  bash gpu/hwcodec/tests/hw/vdec/run_tests.sh
  N2VLD checks 912 pass 912          (x2: ASan+UBSan -O1, -O2)
  N2VLDV checks 478 pass 478         (x2: the phone's libvcodecdrv.so under the A32 interpreter)
  DEC03 arm64 iOS compile: n2vld.c ok
  N2TEST DEC03 PASS 2781/2781
  21 s, builds under /tmp/n2hw-DEC03 (~7 MB).
Optional oracle:
  bash gpu/hwcodec/tests/hw/vdec/oracle_ref.sh -> N2TEST DEC03-oracle PASS 12/12

What the vendor differential proves: H264_HAL_ShiftGetBitStream / AVCVLDGetBitS / GetRealBitStream / GetBitStreamShift / UeCodeNum / SeCodeNum and the vdec_hal_h264_* / vdec_hal_h265_* readers return the same spec literals under the phone's own machine code; parseSPS + vdec_com_h264_getinfofromsps still match ffprobe on 320x240, 1920x1080, 1920x808. What it does not prove: the real MT6893 bits, and which hal context (core vs LAT) the live path uses.

Not done / unresolved (also in dsh-state/workers/DEC03/STATUS.md):
1. T02 hook not landed. tests/hw/n2vc_hw_fake.c has no n2vc_hw_fake_set_reg_hook; the suite drives the exact signature through t_vld.c's bridge. I posted exact text to hw-t02: one setter + READ/WRITE/WRITE_MASK/POLL call sites; the POLL loop matters (VLD 0xe8 / AVC 0x2d8). Window 12 (VDEC_ALL) still needs DEC07/DEC04/T02.
2. LAT vs core is [I]; the model has both, so the fake must power the right domain (VDE for LAT, VDE2 for core).
3. No decode completion: no done IRQ, no error/finish status, no MC/MV/PP/pixels. A decode START can stall after the reader part.
4. VLD 0x3b/0x34/0x3f units and 0x50/0x33 bits are [I] beyond the vendor formula; read(n) post-shift window is [V] from the vendor thunk but the barrel alignment is [I].
5. EPB across a ring end / a trailing 00 00 03 with no following byte is not fully specified; tested cases are in REGISTERS.md §8.
6. HEVC_VLD is implemented and vendor-tested for ue/se/peek/shift/trailing; the HEVC frame path is not.
7. No phone, no publish.

Corrected oracle (important for DEC01/DEC05/DEC06 and reviewers): vsi.pic.pic_w/pic_h and buf_w/buf_h are CODED sizes; vsi.crop[2..3] is the display rectangle. 320x240 -> pic 320x240, buf 320x256, crop 0,0,320,240; 1920x1080 -> pic 1920x1088, buf 1920x1088, crop 0,0,1920,1080; 1920x808 -> pic 1920x816, buf 1920x832, crop 0,0,1920,808; changed=0x23. Do not compare pic_h to ffprobe for cropped streams.

Files: gpu/hwcodec/tests/hw/vdec/{n2vld.h,n2vld.c,t_vld.c,t_vendor.c,run_tests.sh,oracle_ref.sh,REGISTERS.md}, gpu/hwcodec/dsh-state/workers/DEC03/STATUS.md. 120 KB, no file over 300 KB, SPDX MIT. Staying available for review findings.
